mapper.select: SELECT chatbot_id, member_id, session_key, chatbot_status FROM CHATBOT WHERE session_key = #{sessionKey} AND chatbot_status = 'ACTIVE' LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CHATBOT ( member_id, session_key, chatbot_status ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{sessionKey}, 'ACTIVE' )
mapper.select: SELECT message_id, sender_type, message_content, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS created_at FROM CHATBOT_MESSAGE WHERE chatbot_id = #{chatbotId} ORDER BY message_id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE CHATBOT SET chatbot_status = 'ENDED', ended_at = NOW() WHERE session_key = #{sessionKey} AND chatbot_status = 'ACTIVE'
